To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the reaction of tetraethoxy-silane with triethanolamine in equimolar amounts in the presence of a heterocyclic hydroxyl-containing compounds leads to the formation of 1-(heterocyclic)oxy-1-silacyclohexane (heterocyclic silatranes).
1-derivates of silatran are novel heterocyclic 2-derivates of tetraethyloxysilane.

1-(heterocyclyloxy) silatranes were obtained by transesterification reaction of tetraethoxy silane with equimolar mixture triethanolamine with heterocyclic (aromatic) hydroxyl containing compound, and the obtained compounds were characterized by IR, 1H-NMR, 13C-NMR spectroscopy, and elemental analysis.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of heterocyclic 2-substituted-1-(heteroaryloxy)trisiloxanes.
the development of new synthetic procedures for the synthesis of 1-alkoxysilatranes and 1-heterocyclic (or aryl) silatranes.
the synthesis of heterocyclic 2- and 3-derivatives of the silatranes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the 1-arylsilatranes and 1-heteroarylsilatranses are the most stable and the 1-alkylsilatranes the least stable silatranes, and this order is in accordance with the stability order of siloxanes.
the 1-heterosubstituted silatranes were prepared by the reaction of a mixture of triethoxysilanol and a heterocycle (or an aromatic compound) containing an OH-group.
1-(heteroaryl)-silatrane synthesis can be achieved via the transesterification reaction of triethanol amine with the appropriate heteroaryl alcohol in the presence of tetraethoxy silane.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we were the first to introduce the silatranes as a novel class of compounds.
we have developed a new synthetic method for the synthesis of heterocyclic 2-oxo-1-silatranes.

The main takeaway from our work is that
we have developed a general method for the synthesis of heteroaryl 1-silatranes, and that these compounds have a wide range of applications.
1-heterosilatrane derivatives can be obtained from an equimolar reaction of a heterocycle (or an aromatic hydroxyl-containing) compound and tetraethoxylsilane.
the 1-heteroaryl-1-silatranes can be obtained by a transesterification reaction of tetraethoxy silane with a mixture of triethoxysilanol and an appropriate heterocyclic hydroxy compound.
